display_title: StatBall: A Stats-Powered Baseball Review Game
one_liner: Classroom-tested final-exam review: teams earn a salary cap from a 30-question stats quiz, draft players in a silent auction, and play a 2d6 dice-baseball tournament.
problem: Cumulative review before the term-end exam is usually passive and low-engagement.
approach: I built a Streamlit quiz that pays out a salary cap and writes results to Google Sheets, mapped real OBP, SLG and ERA onto 2d6 dice probability tables, and wrote a scouting guide around expected bases per plate appearance using the law of total expectation.
decision_relevance: Turns probability tables and expected value into resource-allocation decisions under a budget, which parallels analytic tradeoffs.

headline_results.claim: A 30-question statistics quiz sets each team's salary cap; teams then draft players in a silent auction and play a 2d6 dice-baseball tournament
Dice tables built from real OBP, SLG and ERA: P(2d6 >= 6) x E[bases | hit] = 26/36 x 2.333 = 1.684 expected bases per plate appearance
All 30 answer keys re-derived and verified
Classroom-tested as the final-exam review in MA206, with submissions collected through Google Sheets

limitations: Q16 uses causal wording for a regression slope
Needs Google service account to run submissions
blockers_before_featuring: Confirm the demo URL (statball.streamlit.app) is live
